mapper.select: SELECT es.*, u.NAME as USER_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME as DEPARTMENT_NAME, su.NAME as SHARED_BY_NAME, e.TITLE as EVENT_TITLE FROM TB_EVENT_SHARE es INNER JOIN TB_EVENT e ON es.EVENT_ID = e.EVENT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_USER u ON es.USERNAME = u.USERNAME LEFT JOIN TB_DEPARTMENT d ON u.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN TB_USER su ON es.SHARED_BY = su.USERNAME WHERE es.EVENT_ID = #{eventId} AND es.DELETED_AT IS NULL AND es.SHARE_TYPE != 'TRANSFER' ORDER BY es.SHARED_AT DESC

SELECT es.*, u.NAME as USER_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME as DEPARTMENT_NAME, su.NAME as SHARED_BY_NAME, e.TITLE as EVENT_TITLE FROM TB_EVENT_SHARE es INNER JOIN TB_EVENT e ON es.EVENT_ID = e.EVENT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_USER u ON es.USERNAME = u.USERNAME LEFT JOIN TB_DEPARTMENT d ON u.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN TB_USER su ON es.SHARED_BY = su.USERNAME WHERE es.EVENT_ID = #{eventId} AND es.USERNAME = #{username} AND es.DELETED_AT IS NULL AND es.SHARE_TYPE != 'TRANSFER'

SELECT es.*, u.NAME as USER_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME as DEPARTMENT_NAME, su.NAME as SHARED_BY_NAME, e.TITLE as EVENT_TITLE FROM TB_EVENT_SHARE es INNER JOIN TB_EVENT e ON es.EVENT_ID = e.EVENT_ID AND e.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN TB_USER u ON es.USERNAME = u.USERNAME LEFT JOIN TB_DEPARTMENT d ON u.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN TB_USER su ON es.SHARED_BY = su.USERNAME WHERE es.USERNAME = #{username} AND es.DELETED_AT IS NULL AND es.SHARE_TYPE != 'TRANSFER' ORDER BY es.SHARED_AT DESC
